description: This script automates the import of incomplete VMray analyses into MISP, configured via inline settings and executed periodically via cron. It interacts with MISP server settings, performs API calls to VMray, and updates MISP events with analysis data.

classes.name: VMRayAutomationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for VMRay automation errors.

classes.name: VMRayAutomation
classes.description: Main class handling VMRay import automation, including configuration, API interactions, and event updates.

methods.name: _setting_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a boolean setting is enabled; raises exception if not.

methods.name: _setting_url
methods.description: Validates and returns a URL setting.

methods.name: _setting_disabled
methods.description: Interprets a string as a boolean disabled flag.

methods.name: _services_port
methods.description: Returns default port 6666 if input is 0, otherwise returns input.

methods.name: services_url
methods.description: Validates and returns a services URL.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Fetches and sets configuration from MISP server settings.

methods.name: overwrite_config
methods.description: Overrides current configuration with provided dictionary.

methods.name: _get_sample_id
methods.description: Extracts sample ID from a string with prefix 'VMRay Sample ID: '.

methods.name: _call_vmray_import
methods.description: Calls the VMray import API with sample ID and event ID.

methods.name: _add_event_attributes
methods.description: Adds attributes to a MISP event.

methods.name: _add_event_objects
methods.description: Adds objects and tags to a MISP event.

methods.name: _add_misp_event
methods.description: Adds analysis results to a MISP event, either as attributes or objects based on config.

methods.name: import_incomplete_analyses
methods.description: Searches for incomplete analyses in MISP and processes each event.
